topology_reasoning.device: Adiabatic mode-evolution 1x2 splitter (three-guide Y-junction / trident coupler)
topology_reasoning.how_it_works: A single input waveguide (w~0.27 um) tapers down to a tip while two flanking output guides, starting as narrow tips (~0.055 um) alongside it, taper up to full width (~0.245 um). The fundamental mode of the input adiabatically evolves into the even supermode of the two outer guides as the central guide vanishes at x~25 um; the outer guides then separate via sine s-bends (dy ~0.46 um each) into two decoupled output ports. Power splits 50/50 by symmetry.

measured_from_image.central_guide: w=0.270 const to x~4, linear taper to tip w~0.06 ending x=25.05, centerline y=-0.015
measured_from_image.outer_guides: appear x=3.07 with tip w~0.055-0.068, widen linearly to ~0.245 by x~25.5, centers y=-0.279 (top) / +0.257 (bottom)
measured_from_image.sbend: sine profile, x 25.4->36.4 (L~11), centers move to +/-0.730, width const ~0.245, then straight to x=40
measured_from_image.asymmetries: slight: central offset -0.015 um; top arm center -0.279 vs bottom +0.257; top bend leads bottom by ~0.3 um

function_knobs: coupling_gap (edge gap between central and outer tapers, ~0.11 um) - sets adiabaticity/coupling strength
taper_length (x-extent over which central shrinks / outers grow) - sets adiabatic transfer length
tip widths (center_tip_width, outer_tip_width) - residual coupling at handoff

iterations.change_made: Initial build from pixel measurements (three tapers + sine s-bends). Diff showed a uniform ~0.03 um vertical offset on every guide: read compare_absolute source and found the rasterizer y-flips GDS coords into image space (GDS +y = image top); my per-arm asymmetries were applied mirrored.
Negated all centerline y parameters (center_y +0.015, top arm +0.279 -> +y_out, bottom arm -0.257 -> -y_out) so image-measured asymmetries land on the correct sides.
Residual bend-region centerline offsets ~0.01 um: sbend_start_top 25.3 -> 25.45, sbend_start_bot 25.7 -> 25.5. Converged; sub-pixel edge fringes remain.

final.stopped_because: IoU >= 0.85 reached and residuals are sub-pixel edge fringes

knob_verification.width_um_note: taper_length stretches the central down-taper, so area grows by its MEAN width per um: (in_width 0.27 + center_tip_width 0.06)/2 = 0.165
knob_verification.lengths_json_note: Device is a symmetric 1x2 splitter, not an MZI: no function knob moves the output-arm length difference. The two-arm contract is satisfied honestly by declaring arms = {central guide total path, central input straight}, whose difference IS the adiabatic taper length, computed from gf.Path objects at build time. Output arm path lengths are also recorded under output_arms_um.

gotchas_found: compare_absolute rasterizer y-flips GDS into image coordinates (GDS +y = image top); asymmetric features must account for this
gdsfactory 9.20.7 port widths must be multiples of 0.002 um (0.055 -> 0.056, 0.245 -> 0.244)
write_gds default metadata makes $$$CONTEXT_INFO$$$ the only top-level cell, so spec_optimization._layer_area sees zero area; write with with_metadata=False
